editorial:
Imagine trying to balance a fancy new internship with a boyfriend who is basically a human thunderstorm. That is exactly what you get here. You will follow Tessa and Hardin as they try to make their rocky relationship work while dealing with family secrets and new people trying to get between them. The vibe is very dramatic and moody, focusing on that intense, all-consuming kind of young love that feels like it could explode at any second. It is less about a plot and more about the emotional roller coaster these two ride together.

What really stands out is the chemistry between the leads, though the constant fighting might get a bit tiring for some of you. The pacing is decent, but the real draw is the soap-opera style drama. If you enjoy stories about messy relationships and big emotional outbursts, you will love this.
endingExplained: The story wraps up with a huge shock when Tessa finds out that Hardin's father is actually her biological father. This twist changes everything and leaves both of them feeling completely broken. Even though they are devastated by this family secret, they decide to try and stay together. They end the movie by choosing to face the pain as a couple, hoping their love is strong enough to survive such a weird and difficult truth.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves intense romance and messy relationship drama.
